title: Fermentation Complete Detection
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| timechart span=1d avg(gravity) as sg
| streamstats current=f last(sg) as prev_sg
| eval change=abs(sg-prev_sg), done=if(change<0.001,1,0)
description: Detects when specific gravity stops falling for consecutive days, the signal that fermentation has finished and the beer is ready to package.
value: A stable gravity for several days is the only reliable sign fermentation is done; automating it prevents bottling too early and making bombs.
implementation: Ingest daily gravity; flag when the day-over-day change stays near zero, indicating a finished ferment.
visualization: Line chart of daily gravity flattening to a stable finish.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when your beer has stopped fermenting so you know it is safe to bottle without risk of exploding bottles.
